summary: CAD STL preview fix verified end-to-end after fixing a second parse-time regression introduced by E1's change. (1) E1's three.js pin to 0.144 (via VIEWER_HTML template) actually broke the WHOLE Model3DViewer.tsx module at parse time, because the new comment used double backticks ('``examples/js/``') INSIDE the outer template literal — that prematurely closes the template, the next '``' opens an empty tagged-template, and JS evaluates the giant HTML string as if it were a function -> 'TypeError: "<!doctype html>..." is not a function'. This crashed /cad-files/<id> and /cad-files/preview/<id> with an Uncaught Error red screen. (2) I replaced the backticks in the comment with plain text and re-tested. After the fix: T1 public STL (threejs.org colored.stl) -> real gold mesh paints inside the iframe canvas (canvas 390x705), no banner. T2 Astronaut.glb -> model-viewer loads (mv.loaded=true), Astronaut visible. T3 tap cube on the seeded engagement-ring-v3.stl row -> three.js+STLLoader load successfully and STLLoader emits its own 'Failed to load STL: ... 404' banner because the seeded secure_url points to https://res.cloudinary.com/demo/raw/upload/v123/engagement-ring-v3.stl which 404s (pre-existing fixture issue, not this bug). The original 'Failed to load STL viewer: [object Event]' banner is gone — script-load step no longer fails (jsdelivr 3.0.144 build/three.min.js, examples/js/loaders/STLLoader.js and examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js all 200 OK, verified via curl).
action_items: OPTIONAL (seed data): Replace the demo CAD seed URL https://res.cloudinary.com/demo/raw/upload/v123/engagement-ring-v3.stl (returns 404) with a real working STL, e.g. https://threejs.org/examples/models/stl/binary/colored.stl, so the existing test order shows a rendered model on tap. The viewer itself is fine — this is a stale fixture in the order seeder.
REMINDER: Any future edit to VIEWER_HTML must avoid backticks anywhere inside the outer template literal (they end it). If backticks are needed in the HTML, escape with \` .
critical_code_review_comments: Model3DViewer.tsx defines VIEWER_HTML as a top-level template literal that embeds JS source as a string. ANY backtick inside that string terminates the literal silently. The fix used '``examples/js/``' which broke the entire module at parse time and crashed every screen that imports Model3DViewer (incl. /cad-files/<id> because it imports isPreviewable from the same module).
The previous-iteration auth playbook compliance is unrelated to this bug, no auth deviation observed.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of original bug (E1's diagnosis correct): three@0.160 dropped examples/js/, so /loaders/STLLoader.js and /controls/OrbitControls.js 404'd from the iframe, the Promise.catch fired 'Failed to load STL viewer: [object Event]'. Fix (pin to 0.144) is correct. SECONDARY BUG E1 introduced and I fixed: the comment in the new fix used '``examples/js/``' double-backticks INSIDE the outer JavaScript template literal `VIEWER_HTML = `...``, which silently closed the template literal and turned the rest into a tagged-template invocation -> TypeError at module-load, red-screen on every /cad-files screen. Reproduction: navigate to /cad-files/<orderId> as admin -> 'Uncaught Error' overlay pointing at Model3DViewer.tsx:89:9. Mitigation: replace inner double-backticks with plain text (committed).
